extras.approval_status: APPROVED by project owner 2026-08-27, per plan.md decision D7. Core coalition facts (government_groups_citation below) approved as-is. The open question is resolved — see resolved_questions: Ostravak and STAROSTOVÉ pro OSTRAVU are treated as in the coalition for the WHOLE term (single 6-klub government_groups window since=2022-10-19, no split into two definition files needed), per the owner's explicit choice given the schema's since/until-per-org limitation and the genuinely conflicting sources.

government_groups_citation.claim: Original 2022 coalition (from the term's 2022-10-19 constituting session): ANO 2011 + 'Koalice SPOLU' (which fields two separate assembly klubs, 'ODS + TOP09' and 'KDU-ČSL' — confirmed as two distinct registered klubs directly from vote-page data, not just the election-list label) + Piráti. Tomáš Macura (ANO 2011) continued as mayor.

December 2022-February 2023: part of ANO 2011's own klub left after an internal dispute, reducing the coalition's seat count. Confirmed directly from primary vote-page data (not just news): meeting 202302 (2023-02-22) still shows the original 8-klub structure with ANO 2011 intact; meeting 202303 (2023-03-22) shows a new transitional klub 'Nezařazení' (unaffiliated) appear for the first time, containing the departing members.
sources: ostrava.cz vysledky_hlasovani vote pages themselves (see ostrava/scripts/party_affiliation.py's module docstring for the exact dated evidence trail) — a primary-source citation, not an external news claim

government_groups_citation.claim: 2023-04-25: a NEW, broadened coalition agreement was signed — ANO 2011 + ODS+TOP09 + KDU-ČSL + Ostravak + STAROSTOVÉ pro OSTRAVU + Piráti (37/55 seats), with Jan Dohnal (ODS, of the 'ODS + TOP09' klub) replacing Macura as mayor. Confirmed both by news AND primary vote data: meeting 202304 (2023-04-26, the very next meeting after this agreement) shows the departing ANO members' transitional 'Nezařazení' klub replaced by a new klub, 'JDETO!!!' — and this 6-klub coalition set (ANO 2011/ODS+TOP09/KDU-ČSL/Ostravak/STAROSTOVÉ pro OSTRAVU/Piráti) is the one that persists, unchanged, through the last dated klub snapshot (meeting 202505, 2025-06-18) — see party_affiliation.py's klub history.

resolved_questions.question: Were Ostravak and STAROSTOVÉ pro OSTRAVU ALSO part of the ORIGINAL 2022-10-19 coalition, or did they only join when the coalition was broadened on 2023-04-25? Sources genuinely conflict: one 2022-10-20 iROZHLAS piece frames the initial coalition as ANO+SPOLU+Piráti with 'Ostravak se asi nepřidá' ('Ostravak probably won't join'), and a Patriot Magazín headline from the same period reads 'Ostravak je i tentokrát z kola ven' ('Ostravak is out of the running again this time') — both suggesting they were NOT in the original coalition. No source explicitly confirms exclusion for the full ~6 months, only that it was uncertain/contested at the time.
resolved_questions.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-08-27 by project owner: treated as in the coalition for the WHOLE term (single 6-klub government_groups window, since=2022-10-19) — the simpler modeling choice, given the govity-definition.dt.analyses schema has no since/until per org (a 'joined later' answer would have required splitting this into two definition files) and the conflicting sources don't clearly establish exclusion.
resolved_questions.reopen_if: A future re-check finds a citation that clearly and specifically confirms Ostravak/STAROSTOVÉ pro OSTRAVU were excluded from the coalition for a defined period — at that point the two-definition-file split described in the original draft's recommendation would need to be built.

extras.not_investigated: Whether SPOLU's own internal ODS/TOP09/KDU-ČSL composition, or any of the other 4 coalition klubs, had further internal changes not visible as a klub-level event is out of scope — this repo models each feed-reported klub as one org, no sub-party split available, same scope boundary as Praha's SPOLU pro Prahu and Brno's precedent.
